product_one_liner.value: DataGrail is an enterprise privacy-management platform for privacy, legal, and security teams that automates data discovery and mapping, data-subject requests, consent management, and privacy-risk assessment.
product_one_liner.notes: The documentation describes DataGrail as a privacy platform for brands and identifies data discovery and mapping, DSR management, consent management, and privacy risk assessment as its core areas for privacy, legal, and security teams.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer list no pricing link, and the checked pricing URL returned only a 302 response rather than a public pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: DataGrail has an Engineering blog category and at least two relevant posts: one discusses engineering practices and infrastructure, and the API Design Series post discusses design choices for integrations and APIs. The category and technical content support a true answer, though the authors’ engineering job titles are not explicit in every cited excerpt.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation lists multiple product help articles, including Email Notifications and Privacy Dashboard.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current DataGrail job board lists three openings—Senior Customer Success Manager, IT & Business Systems Manager, and Senior Demand Generation Manager—and none is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was the $45 million Series C announced October 12, 2022, well before the 18-month lookback window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live DataGrail Enterprise Account Executive posting includes an Apply option, satisfying the role-title condition.

launched_6mo.notes: The dated June 23, 2026 post announces DataGrail Data Broker Compliance, a product launch within the six months before November 9, 2026.
